bias.en: Bearish · oversold, holding $167–169 after the slide
bias.zh: 看空 · 超卖，急跌后守在 $167–169

read.en: Marvell rose 0.3% on Nov 3 to $171.97, trading between $167.40 and $177.31 on 1.5 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($201.95), 10-day ($218.39), 30-day ($246.82) and 100-day ($236.49) averages and the rising 200-day ($184.11). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 29 ($246.16), and RSI is 29.
read.zh: Marvell 11月3日上涨 0.3%，收于 $171.97，盘中区间 $167.40–177.31，成交量为 20 日均量的 1.5 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$201.95）、10 日（$218.39）、30 日（$246.82）和 100 日均线（$236.49）以及上行的 200 日均线（$184.11）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月29日起看空（$246.16），RSI 为 29。

read.en: The slide paused: an intraday dip to $167.40 undercut the Nov 2 low but the $169.5 support zone held on a closing basis, and the bounce stalled under the $178 Jul 17 low. Resistance is $177.3–178, then $184.1 (200-day) and $190.2–192.3. Support is $167.4–168.5 (Nov 2–3 lows), then $162.9 (Jul 29 low) and $158. A close above $178 would target $184; below $167.4, $163.
